evals.name: direct-decision
evals.prompt: Specify an age band calculator at the inclusive boundary of 18.
evals.expected_output: One concrete when context, one act, one observable expectation.
assertions: Calls the calculation once in Because.
Asserts the captured result inside a Fact without booting a host.

evals.name: discovery-only
evals.prompt: A Release job lists should_round_down but shows no individual test outcomes. Has the behavior been verified?
evals.expected_output: Ask for execution rather than discovery.
assertions: Does not report the case as passing.
Checks Release inputs and matching xUnit v3 adapter if the case disappears.
Runs the built spec project and verifies the named fact passed.

evals.name: shared-context
evals.prompt: Two discount specs construct the same calculator but make different purchases. Organize them.
evals.expected_output: Share only setup between distinct actions.
assertions: Moves common construction to a given context.
Keeps one purchase in each concrete Because.
Avoids mutable state shared between runs.
